items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: his mother had the policeman to break the door down in Kansas City to get him and Tadd Dameron out of the room; they had been in the room for four months practicing.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, he could play. He had all his facilities, once they got his nerves...once he got his energies back where his nerves were under control. And he was doing really good. And he always did talk, you know, with sense. He was never crazy really, you know.

But before that, we had talked about how he became involved in the drug situation. He explained to me it happened to him when he was about 14 years old. And he also told me how his mother had the policeman to break the door down in Kansas City to get him and Tadd Dameron out of the room; they had been in the room for four months practicing. They'd take everything they needed in that room, and just lock up. See, that's the way he did it. He out-practiced everybody. Besides being treasured with that genius, he…
